YPNDKRsWCW3Z5DghDGQCZQ.zh: 印度公布近年疫情顯著下降,2015-25年病例數與死亡數均下降約80%,高疾病負擔行政區自155個降至33個,且有160個區域於2022-25年無報告本土病例,當局將持續加強疫情監測、檢驗、治療與追蹤,目標於2030年消除瘧疾。
YPNDKRsWCW3Z5DghDGQCZQ.en: India has announced a marked decline in malaria in recent years: cases and deaths both fell by about 80% between 2015 and 2025. The number of high-burden districts fell from 155 to 33, and 160 areas reported no locally acquired cases during 2022–25. Authorities will continue to strengthen malaria surveillance, testing, treatment and case tracing, with the aim of eliminating malaria by 2030.

az6CHlipEOP5wLkL7a_vPw.zh: 最新研究公布印度2023年估計有490萬例病例,其中73萬例住院、7,850例死亡,9歲以下兒童住院及死亡風險最高,82%住院病例產生氟喹諾酮類(Fluoroquinolone)抗生素抗藥性,抗藥性菌株已成為住院與死亡主因。故WHO於8/14調整傷寒疫苗接種指引,建議加強高風險兒童之保護及施打疫苗追加劑。
az6CHlipEOP5wLkL7a_vPw.en: A recent study estimates that India had 4.9 million typhoid cases in 2023, of which 730,000 were hospitalised and 7,850 died. Children under 9 have the highest risk of hospitalisation and death. 82% of hospitalised cases showed resistance to fluoroquinolone antibiotics, and resistant strains have become a leading cause of hospitalisation and death. WHO therefore updated its typhoid vaccination guidance on 14 August, recommending stronger protection for high-risk children and booster doses.

HMPvbd-gh0VZUXrxUt4VPA.zh: 菲律賓宿霧省(Cebu)疫情上升,今年截至8/18累計報告2,324例病例,其中17例死亡,自7月進入雨季以來積水增加,致疫情顯著上升;鄰近之薄荷省(Bohol)亦爆發疫情,今年截至8/22累計報告1,883例病例,較去年同期增加7%,已至少20例死亡,致死率(CFR:1.17%)已超過該國設定之流行閾(1%),且全省12 個行政區已連續3週逾流行閾,疫情以塔利邦(Talibon)、塔比拉蘭(Tagbilaran City)及烏拜(Ubay)最為嚴重,當局已宣佈進入疫情警示。 馬來西亞疫情快速上升,今年迄今累計報告逾6.2萬例病例,其中60例死亡,疫情較去年同期增加60%。當局已啟動應變中,於吉隆坡與雪蘭莪州(Selangor )等熱點部署,擴大釋放沃爾巴克氏菌(Wolbachia)轉染的蚊子以進行生物防治,並進行登革熱疫苗成本效益分析,評估可能納入國家常規疫苗接種計畫。 印度今年截至7月累計報告3萬3,060例病例,與去年同期相當,其中7月新增1萬122例,較6月增加53%。該國病例通常於每年5-6月(季風雨季開始)呈現上升趨勢,並在9-10月達到全年高峰。 歐洲今年截至8/5僅有法國報告4例本土病例。研究顯示因為氣候變遷因素,2015-24年歐洲的疫情發生風險,為1982-2010年的3倍。
HMPvbd-gh0VZUXrxUt4VPA.en: In Cebu Province, Philippines, dengue is rising: as of 18 August this year, 2,324 cases have been reported cumulatively, including 17 deaths; standing water has increased since the rainy season began in July, causing a marked rise. Neighbouring Bohol Province has also had an outbreak: as of 22 August this year, 1,883 cases have been reported cumulatively, 7% more than the same period last year, with at least 20 deaths. The case fatality rate (1.17%) exceeds the country's epidemic threshold (1%), and 12 administrative areas across the province have exceeded the threshold for three consecutive weeks; the outbreak is most serious in Talibon, Tagbilaran City and Ubay. Authorities have declared an outbreak alert. Malaysia's outbreak is rising rapidly: as of this year, more than 62,000 cases have been reported cumulatively, including 60 deaths, 60% more than the same period last year. Authorities have activated a response and are deploying hotspot measures in Kuala Lumpur and Selangor, expanding the release of Wolbachia-infected mosquitoes for biological control, and conducting a cost-effectiveness analysis of a dengue vaccine to assess whether it could be included in the national routine vaccination programme. India reported 33,060 cases cumulatively through July this year, similar to the same period last year; 10,122 were added in July, 53% more than in June. Cases in India usually rise from May to June, at the start of the monsoon rains, and reach an annual peak in September–October. In Europe, as of 5 August this year, only France had reported 4 locally acquired cases. Studies show that climate change has made the risk of dengue outbreaks in Europe during 2015–24 three times that of 1982–2010.

j2Ara_A-etjEi8K3d9nqog.zh: 全球自2022年迄2026年6月底,共145個國家/地區累計報告188,847例確定病例及521例死亡,致死率約0.3%。目前疫情風險主要集中於非洲,馬達加斯加自2025年12月起爆發目前全球最大規模疫情,已有61%行政區受影響,近期檢驗陽性率達74%,疫情尚未獲控制;剛果⺠主共和國則持續有Clade Ia及Ib共同流行,惟監測及檢驗量能下降,可能低估實際疫情規模;巴基斯坦年初發生Clade Ib院內群聚,34例確定病例中有8例嬰幼兒死亡。另全球於英國、印度及卡達發現3例Clade Ib/IIb重組病毒株,目前尚無證據顯示其傳播力或疾病嚴重度增加,仍須持續監測。WHO評估維持全球風險為中,主要以高風險性行為族群傳播為主,該族群風險為中,一般大眾則為低。
j2Ara_A-etjEi8K3d9nqog.en: Globally, from 2022 to the end of June 2026, 145 countries and territories have cumulatively reported 188,847 confirmed cases and 521 deaths, a case fatality rate of about 0.3%. Current risk is concentrated mainly in Africa. Madagascar has been experiencing the world's largest current outbreak since December 2025; 61% of its administrative areas have been affected, the recent test positivity rate has reached 74%, and the outbreak is not yet under control. The DRC continues to see co-circulation of clade Ia and Ib, but declining surveillance and testing capacity may underestimate the actual scale of the outbreak. Pakistan had a clade Ib hospital cluster early this year, in which 8 of 34 confirmed cases were infants and young children who died. In addition, 3 recombinant clade Ib/IIb virus strains have been found in the United Kingdom, India and Qatar; there is currently no evidence that transmissibility or disease severity has increased, but monitoring must continue. WHO assesses the global risk as moderate. Transmission is mainly within high-risk sexual networks, where the risk is moderate; for the general public, the risk is low.

ZApDBy4N5VDHBWJzRkAfGA.zh: 泊爾疫情上升,今年截至8/11累計46例確定病例,其中9例死亡(CFR:20%),疫情逐漸向東部特萊平原(Terai)蔓延,相較2025年,以藍毗省最為嚴重。該國疫情流行高峰介於6-10月,惟當局針對高風險區之疫苗接種計畫要到2027年才能展開,預期疫情將持續上升。該國去年累計141例感染,41例死亡(CFR :23%),76%死亡病例年齡大於40歲 ,顯示該疾病正在影響大量超出常規兒童疫苗接種年齡範圍的族群。 印度阿薩姆州(Assam)疫情持續,今年7月報告156例確定病例,其中至少20例死亡(CFR: 12.8%)。自2018年迄今,該州占全國死亡總數達6成。當局已於高風險地區推動疫苗接種(涵蓋率約75%),惟該邦近期面臨洪災,加上正水稻種植及雨季,恐加劇病媒蚊孳生,預期疫情將持續至季風季節結束。
ZApDBy4N5VDHBWJzRkAfGA.en: Nepal's epidemic is rising: as of 11 August this year, 46 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, including 9 deaths (CFR 20%). The outbreak is gradually spreading into the eastern Terai plains, and compared with 2025, Lumbini Province is the most severely affected. The epidemic peak in the country falls between June and October, but the vaccination programme for high-risk areas will not begin until 2027, so cases are expected to keep rising. Last year the country cumulatively recorded 141 infections and 41 deaths (CFR 23%), with 76% of deaths in people over 40, indicating that the disease is affecting many people beyond the age range covered by routine childhood vaccination. In Assam state, India, the outbreak continues: 156 confirmed cases were reported in July this year, of which at least 20 died (CFR 12.8%). Since 2018, the state has accounted for 60% of national deaths. Authorities have promoted vaccination in high-risk areas (coverage about 75%), but the state has recently been hit by flooding, and paddy cultivation and the rainy season may intensify mosquito breeding; the outbreak is expected to continue until the end of the monsoon season.

8f6-2lLDzgmRkKZR5hdSwA.zh: 法屬留旺島今年截至7/23累計報告221例確定病例,其中1例死亡。疫情於3月達高峰(71例)後,隨乾季來臨逐步下降,7月僅報告8例,淡水休閒活動及農業工作為主要暴露風險。今年65% 病例需住院治療,可能與延遲就醫或感染毒力較高之血清群有關。該島歷來以Icterohaemorrhagiae血清群為主要流行菌株,該血清群與較嚴重之臨床表現相關,可能引發韋氏病(Weil disease)。 印度喀拉拉州受雨季影響,疫情大幅上升,今年截至7/31累計報告1,394例確定病例及63例死亡,7月即新增415例確定病例及30例死亡,疫情已擴及至少10個地區,呈全州性傳播趨勢。死亡個案以40至69歲勞工及農業工作者為主,該病死亡數占該州傳染病死亡總數52%。鑑於8月為流行高峰期,且致死率已由4.2%升至6%,當局持續推廣以去氧羥四環素(doxycycline)進行預防性投藥,以抑制疫情。
8f6-2lLDzgmRkKZR5hdSwA.en: Réunion has reported 221 confirmed leptospirosis cases this year as of 23 July, including 1 death. After peaking in March (71 cases), cases declined with the arrival of the dry season, with only 8 cases reported in July. The main exposure risks are recreational freshwater activities and agricultural work. This year, 65% of cases required hospitalization, which may be related to delayed care-seeking or to more virulent infecting serogroups. The island has historically been dominated by the Icterohaemorrhagiae serogroup, which is associated with more severe clinical presentations and can cause Weil disease. In India, Kerala State has seen a sharp rise in cases during the monsoon season. As of 31 July this year, 1,394 confirmed cases and 63 deaths have been reported cumulatively, with 415 confirmed cases and 30 deaths added in July alone. The outbreak has spread to at least 10 areas, showing a statewide transmission trend. Deaths have mainly occurred among workers and agricultural workers aged 40 to 69 years, and leptospirosis accounts for 52% of the state's total infectious disease deaths. As August is the peak season and the case fatality ratio has risen from 4.2% to 6%, authorities continue to promote doxycycline chemoprophylaxis to curb the outbreak.

v6qpTQU5LE1NLOj0Li15NA.zh: 印度南部卡納塔克州(Karnataka)門洛爾市(Mangaluru)7/6報告15例病例,疑感染源為受汙染的供水系統,因多地區皆爆發疫情,當局症擴大採檢,以釐清感染源,並呼籲⺠眾應煮沸飲水並食用熟食。
v6qpTQU5LE1NLOj0Li15NA.en: In Mangaluru city, Karnataka State, southern India, 15 cases were reported on 6 July. The suspected source of infection is a contaminated water supply system. Because outbreaks have occurred in multiple areas, authorities have expanded testing to clarify the source of infection, and urge the public to boil drinking water and eat cooked food.

XD3Wq_UR_ruoU6Q54EHHFQ.zh: 印度賈坎德州東新奔縣爆發疫情,自6/24-7/2累計報告150例腦性瘧疾(cerebral malaria)病例,其中4例兒童死亡,致死率約2.7%,6/30單日檢出26例腦性瘧疾病例,顯示於當地持續傳播。賈坎德州為該國惡性瘧原蟲(P. falciparum)感染病例數較多地區之一。 法屬馬約特島疫情上升,今年截至6/21累計報告244例確定病例,其中已知161例為境外移入(95.6%來自葛摩)、25例為本土病例,今年累計244例病例數已高於去年全年111例,且疫情已於希龍吉以外地區傳播,55%病例為15-44歲年齡層族群,目前檢出致病原為惡性瘧原蟲。
XD3Wq_UR_ruoU6Q54EHHFQ.en: In East Singhbhum district, Jharkhand State, India, an outbreak has reported 150 cerebral malaria cases cumulatively from 24 June to 2 July, including 4 child deaths, a fatality ratio of about 2.7%. On 30 June alone, 26 cerebral malaria cases were detected, indicating ongoing local transmission. Jharkhand is one of the states in India with a high number of Plasmodium falciparum infections. In Mayotte, France, cases are rising. As of 21 June this year, 244 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively; of these, 161 were known imported cases (95.6% from Comoros) and 25 were local cases. The 244 cases reported this year already exceed last year's full-year total of 111. The outbreak has spread beyond Chirongui, and 55% of cases are aged 15 to 44 years. The pathogen detected is Plasmodium falciparum.

4UdOOhri6ea9oVaF_2PUsw.zh: 印度南部喀拉拉州(Kerala)科澤科德縣(Kozhikode)報告1例確定病例(前已掌握)。病患為成年男性,於5/30發病,6/10住院,主要出現嚴重神經系統症狀,目前於加護病房插管治療中。截至6/18止,當局已匡列104名接觸者(含45名醫護人員)進行追蹤,目前無新增病例。此為該國今年第2起疫情(前一起為西孟加拉州於2026年1月報告之2例確定病例),WHO評估該國國內傳播風險為中,全球與區域風險為低。
4UdOOhri6ea9oVaF_2PUsw.en: In Kozhikode district of Kerala State, southern India, 1 confirmed case has been reported (previously identified). The patient is an adult man who developed symptoms on 30 May and was hospitalized on 10 June with mainly severe neurological symptoms, and is currently intubated in intensive care. As of 18 June, authorities had identified 104 contacts (including 45 healthcare workers) for follow-up, and no new cases have been found. This is the country's second outbreak this year; the previous one was 2 confirmed cases reported in West Bengal in January 2026. WHO assesses the risk of transmission within the country as moderate and the global and regional risk as low.

KVndG6H0ESMvTZdnm_c-4A.zh: 英國、奧地利、比利時等共10個歐州國家今年截至5月累計報告109例病例,其中1例死亡、18例住院,病患以女性、成人為多,經調查感染源為苜蓿芽種子,由印度進口並分銷歐洲各地,各國已要求廠商將產品下架,ECDC評估此事件對於經常食用者的風險為低至中。
KVndG6H0ESMvTZdnm_c-4A.en: Ten European countries, including the United Kingdom, Austria and Belgium, reported 109 cases cumulatively this year through May, including 1 death and 18 hospitalizations. Patients are mainly female and adults. The source of infection was identified as alfalfa sprout seeds imported from India and distributed across Europe. Countries have required manufacturers to withdraw the products from sale. The ECDC assesses the risk of this event to frequent consumers as low to moderate.

DkSao_GYYivffaKiZATSFQ.zh: 全球陽性率於今年第21週(5/25-31)由低點略升至1.38%,除歐洲外,各區署陽性率明顯增加,整體疫情已連續3週上升。近期全球流行變異株以NB.1.8.1(占48.56%)為主,其次為XFG(占17.31%)及JN.1(占15.87%)。 印度疫情持續上升,第21週陽性率升至3.44%,疫情已連續5週上升。
DkSao_GYYivffaKiZATSFQ.en: The global COVID-19 positivity rate rose slightly from a low point to 1.38% in week 21 of this year (25–31 May), with positivity increasing markedly in all regions except Europe, and overall activity has risen for 3 consecutive weeks. The predominant circulating variants globally are NB.1.8.1 (48.56%), followed by XFG (17.31%) and JN.1 (15.87%). India's outbreak continues to rise: positivity rose to 3.44% in week 21, marking 5 consecutive weeks of increase.

O44RoCazDPcJ6bJ3MDbZug.zh: 印度喀拉拉州科澤科德縣(Kozhikode)於6/11確診1例重症確定病例,為43歲男性,疑清理一座有蝙蝠及鳥類棲息之倉庫而感染,現正插管隔離治療中。因病患確診前曾於院內進行多項檢查,已緊急匡列77名接觸者(58名醫療人員、14名家人與5名朋友),目前均無症狀。當地5至9月為立百病毒傳播高峰期,當局已加強監測。
O44RoCazDPcJ6bJ3MDbZug.en: In Kozhikode, Kerala State, India, a severe confirmed case was diagnosed on 11 June: a 43-year-old man who is suspected to have been infected while cleaning a warehouse inhabited by bats and birds. He is intubated and in isolation for treatment. Because multiple tests were performed at the hospital before the diagnosis, authorities have urgently identified 77 contacts (58 healthcare workers, 14 family members and 5 friends), all currently asymptomatic. The region's Nipah transmission peak is May to September, and authorities have strengthened surveillance.

e-qkM-LLvSTTvvNVE6ufqw.zh: 印度喀拉拉州科澤科德(Kozhikode)於6/10報告1例病例,初步檢測陽性, 為40多歲男性,可能於清理倉庫時,疑有蝙蝠出沒 ,導致感染,該患者最初出現發燒症狀,隨後康復,之後又出現第二次發燒;在此期間,他多次就醫,疑在隔離前造成大量的接觸暴露,該個案已被隔離並接受進一步的檢驗確認。另該國2001-2024年累計報告102例病例,其中74例死亡(CFR:73%)。
e-qkM-LLvSTTvvNVE6ufqw.en: On 10 June, Kozhikode in Kerala State, India, reported one case that tested positive in preliminary testing. The patient is a man in his 40s who may have been infected while clearing a warehouse where bats were suspected to be present. He initially had fever and recovered, then developed a second fever. During this period he sought medical care several times, and significant contact exposure may have occurred before isolation. The case has been isolated and is undergoing further laboratory confirmation. The country reported 102 cases cumulatively from 2001 to 2024, of which 74 were fatal (CFR: 73%).

x0YgmFJ-i4jFZr08fKzFjw.zh: 剛果民主共和國(DRC)疫情持續攀升,截至5/26累計報告1,011例病例,其中105例確診、233例死亡,致死率(CFR)達23%。加拿大於5/26宣布禁止DRC與烏干達之公民入境,禁令為期90天;泰國5/26宣布自DRC與烏干達入境之旅客須進行21天入境檢疫;印度於各大機場啟動篩檢與監測措施,5/26報告1例自烏干達境外移入之疑病例,於5/27檢驗呈陰性,已排除風險。
x0YgmFJ-i4jFZr08fKzFjw.en: The outbreak in the DRC continues to grow: as of 26 May, 1,011 cases had been reported cumulatively, including 105 confirmed cases and 233 deaths, with a CFR of 23%. On 26 May, Canada announced a 90-day entry ban on citizens of the DRC and Uganda. On the same day, Thailand announced that travellers entering from the DRC and Uganda must undergo 21 days of entry quarantine. India has launched screening and surveillance measures at major airports; on 26 May it reported one suspected case imported from Uganda, which tested negative on 27 May, so the risk was ruled out.

A4YTekrtFfRKr6dbtwJoJQ.zh: 疫情更新:  人類疫情:印度新增1例H5N1病例、中國新增1例H9N2病例。全球今年累計報告23例,分別為13例H9N2、7例H5N1、1例H5N6、1例H10N3、1例H1N2v,個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):今年累計56國家/地區報告3,397起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。   共9國於2026/5/8-15期間報告25起H5N1疫情,波蘭13起、智利4起、加拿大2起、巴西/日本/比利時/法國/美國/阿根廷各1起。 共2國於2026/5/14-15期間報告5起H5 (N untyped)疫情,秘魯3起、美國2起。    美國乳牛感染禽流感自2024年3月迄今累計20州報告1,106起疫情,近期主要集中於愛達荷州;該國廢水監測於2026/5/3-9共422個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中,紐澤西/伊利諾/奧勒岡州共6個採檢點檢出H5陽性。
A4YTekrtFfRKr6dbtwJoJQ.en: Update. Human cases: India reported one new H5N1 case and China one new H9N2 case. Globally, 23 cases have been reported this year: 13 H9N2, 7 H5N1, 1 H5N6, 1 H10N3 and 1 H1N2v. Most cases had exposure to susceptible animals before onset. Animal and avian outbreaks (WAHIS): 56 countries and territories have reported 3,397 high- and low-pathogenicity avian influenza outbreaks this year. Nine countries reported 25 H5N1 outbreaks between 8 and 15 May 2026: Poland 13, Chile 4, Canada 2, and Brazil, Japan, Belgium, France, the United States and Argentina one each. Two countries reported five H5 (N untyped) outbreaks between 14 and 15 May 2026: Peru three and the United States two. US dairy cattle avian influenza has accounted for 1,106 outbreaks reported across 20 states since March 2024, with recent activity concentrated mainly in Idaho. US wastewater monitoring provided results for 422 sampling sites during 3–9 May 2026, of which six sites in New Jersey, Illinois and Oregon detected H5-positive results.

YkKLYELidiROt7bZR1w3Eg.zh: 印度中部馬德亞州報告1件野生象疑炭疽病死亡案例,4/29班達迦老虎保護區1隻4歲半雌象因嚴重出血性腹瀉死亡,臨床症狀顯示炭疽桿菌感染。當局已依規焚毀大象屍體並消毒,同時針對風險人員實施疫苗接種及安全監測,避免人畜共通傳染風險,迄無人類病例。
YkKLYELidiROt7bZR1w3Eg.en: Madhya Pradesh State in central India has reported one suspected anthrax death in a wild elephant. On 29 April, a four-and-a-half-year-old female elephant died of severe haemorrhagic diarrhoea in the Bandhavgarh Tiger Reserve, and clinical signs indicated infection with Bacillus anthracis. Authorities have burned the carcass in accordance with regulations and disinfected the area. Vaccination and safety monitoring are being provided to at-risk personnel to prevent zoonotic transmission. No human cases have been reported.

c0V_LhcNE2LGNx3A2awF5w.zh: 印度喀拉拉州去年報告33例死亡病例,為近5年最高,該邦近期流浪狗攻擊事件增加,該州去年發生 30 萬件流浪犬咬傷事件。當局呼籲制定流浪動物相關管理法規,尤其是狂犬病流行地區。
c0V_LhcNE2LGNx3A2awF5w.en: Kerala State, India, reported 33 rabies deaths last year, the highest in five years. Stray dog attacks have increased recently in the state, which recorded 300,000 stray dog bite incidents last year. Authorities call for regulations on stray animal management, especially in areas where rabies is endemic.

QnimXydqTcCJorJmxlDLgg.zh: 印度西部古加拉特州亞美達巴德市(Ahmedabad)4/1-5累計報告22例感染傷寒桿菌病例,主因為水源受污染及受損的排水系統。另該市去(2025)年累計報告445例傷寒病例,當局表示飲水衛生等設施已逐步改善。
QnimXydqTcCJorJmxlDLgg.en: In Ahmedabad, a city in the western Indian state of Gujarat, 22 cases of typhoid (Salmonella Typhi) infection were reported cumulatively for 1–5 April, mainly due to contaminated water sources and damaged drainage systems. The city reported 445 typhoid cases last year. Authorities say that drinking water hygiene and other facilities have been gradually improved.

k6m_Y5dcjvRODibrsUMBag.zh: 印度南部喀拉拉(Kerala)發布今年4至9月季節性警報,當地近年疫情已顯著降溫,2021-2025年累計報告約12例,遠低於2018年之23例(含21例死亡)。當局除宣導民眾避免食用受汙染水果及接觸患病動物外;鑑於過去曾發生因接觸病患體液而導致之院內感染,亦規範醫療機構落實嚴感控措施,防範人傳人風險。
k6m_Y5dcjvRODibrsUMBag.en: Kerala State in southern India has issued a seasonal alert for April to September this year. Although local activity has declined markedly in recent years, with about 12 cases reported cumulatively for 2021–2025, this is far below the 23 cases (including 21 deaths) recorded in 2018. In addition to educating the public to avoid eating contaminated fruit and contact with infected animals, authorities, given past hospital-acquired infections from contact with patients' body fluids, have also required healthcare facilities to implement strict infection control measures to prevent human-to-human transmission.

SRWlcsopeMe8pi7ASxrsow.zh: 義大利北部倫巴第大區報告歐洲首例H9N2流感人類感染病例,病患來自非歐洲國家且於該地感染,感染前健康狀況不佳,住院治療中。另已啟動專家小組,以利與相關國際機構進行協調,並持續監控中。 全球約90%報告H9N2病例報告自中國,另越南、印度、埃及、塞內加爾及迦納也曾報告過病例,該病毒主要透過直接接觸受感染之家禽或受污染環境傳播,人類感染症狀輕微,尚未有人際間傳播案例。
SRWlcsopeMe8pi7ASxrsow.en: Lombardy Region in northern Italy has reported Europe's first human H9N2 influenza infection. The patient came from a non-European country and was infected there; the patient was in poor health before infection and is being treated in hospital. Authorities have also activated an expert group to coordinate with relevant international agencies, and monitoring continues. Around 90% of H9N2 cases reported globally have come from China; Viet Nam, India, Egypt, Senegal and Ghana have also reported cases. The virus is transmitted mainly through direct contact with infected poultry or contaminated environments; human infections have mild symptoms, and no human-to-human transmission has been reported.

Jjig7Njc3Di0uQcwjnaj0g.zh: 中國今年截至2月累計報告2,106例,雖低於2025年同期(4,515例),惟仍高於2024年同期(1,859)例。 印度克拉拉州埃爾訥古勒姆(Ernakulam)區今年1、2月各報告逾150例病例,疫情為該州歷年最高。 義大利那不勒斯(Naples)3/22新增7例病例,疑因生食餐廳海鮮導致感染,當局表示可能與情人節等假期用餐有關。
Jjig7Njc3Di0uQcwjnaj0g.en: China reported 2,106 cases cumulatively this year through February, lower than the 4,515 cases in the same period of 2025, but still higher than the 1,859 cases in the same period of 2024. In Ernakulam District of Kerala State, India, more than 150 cases were reported in each of January and February this year, the highest for the state in its history. In Naples, Italy, 7 new cases were reported on 22 March. The infection is suspected to have been caused by eating raw seafood at restaurants, and authorities said it may be related to holiday meals such as Valentine's Day.

nTW1aCskiCG2kH6vGB3Kjg.zh: WHO於3/6發布全球快速風險評估,疫情具明顯之地理與季節侷限性,主要集中於東南亞與西太平洋區域之自然宿主分布區,雖致死率高(40-75%),惟人傳人有侷限性,且迄未有持續性社區傳播或跨國擴散的跡象,評估全球傳播風險為低。  去(2025)年印度及孟加拉分別報告4例確定病例,今(2026)年截至3/6印度及孟加拉累計報告3例散發確定個案。主要傳播模式為動物源性溢出(Zoonotic Spillover),人際傳播多侷限於醫療照護之院內感染或家戶密切接觸; 非流行地區風險主要為受感染者或受感染牲畜之跨境輸入,惟於非病毒流行地區,次傳播之可能性極低;前往受影響地區旅客風險極低(惟不為零),須留意直接接觸食果蝠、食用受污染食品或接觸豬、馬等受感染動物者; 發生疫情國家已強化其監測系統、診斷及臨床管理能力,目前臨床上尚無核准之疫苗或藥物,快速病例隔離及接觸者追蹤為防止疫情擴散之有效措施; 建議各國應提升對不明原因腦炎的檢測能力,特別是有流行區旅遊史病例;醫療機構應落實標準防護措施,預防院內感染。WHO 空氣或飛沫傳染病疫情
nTW1aCskiCG2kH6vGB3Kjg.en: On 6 March, WHO issued a global rapid risk assessment. The outbreaks have clear geographic and seasonal limitations and are mainly concentrated in the areas of natural host distribution in Southeast Asia and the Western Pacific. Although the case fatality rate is high (40–75%), human-to-human transmission is limited, and there have been no signs of sustained community transmission or cross-border spread to date. WHO assesses the global transmission risk as low. In 2025, India and Bangladesh each reported 4 confirmed cases, and as of 6 March this year they have cumulatively reported 3 sporadic confirmed cases. The main transmission pattern is zoonotic spillover; human transmission is mostly limited to nosocomial infection in healthcare settings or close household contact. The risk in non-endemic areas is mainly cross-border importation of infected people or infected livestock, and secondary transmission in non-endemic areas is extremely unlikely. The risk to travellers to affected areas is very low (though not zero); attention should be paid to direct contact with fruit bats, consumption of contaminated food, or contact with infected animals such as pigs and horses. Countries with outbreaks have strengthened their surveillance systems and diagnostic and clinical management capacity. There are currently no licensed vaccines or drugs for clinical use; rapid case isolation and contact tracing are effective measures to prevent spread. WHO recommends that countries improve testing capacity for unexplained encephalitis, particularly in cases with a history of travel to endemic areas, and that healthcare facilities implement standard precautions to prevent nosocomial infection. WHO. Airborne or droplet-transmitted disease outbreak.

SydaT1vhYVwa3HYYx6oXHA.zh: 每月更新:  全球自2022年截至今(2026)年1/31累計144國/地區報告17萬9千餘例確診病例,其中,至少483例死亡。 今年1月共計50國家/地區報告1,334 例新增確診病例,其中3例死亡,66%來自非洲地區,相較去年12月,歐洲區病例數上升,其餘地區疫情下降。全球各區疫情皆呈下降趨勢,葛摩及法屬留旺島通報首例 Ib 型病例。 非洲地區近6週(2026/1/5-2/15)共計20國通報1,142例確診病例,其中4例死亡,以剛果民主共和國、幾內亞、馬達加斯加、賴比瑞亞及迦納為高;非洲以外地區,法國、葡萄牙及西班牙持續出現Ib型社區傳播。 WHO 於 2 月發布全球快速風險評估,性接觸仍是跨國擴散主因,全球傳播風險評估為中,對MSM群體(尤其未固定性伴侶族群)傳播風險為中,對一般民眾傳播風險為低。 全球目前累計報告2例Ib 及IIb 型基因片段之重組病毒株,分別為於英國報告具東南亞旅遊史,以及印度報告具阿拉伯半島國家旅遊史之病患,基因定序顯示其為相同重組病毒株。WHO表示實際病例數可能多於目前通報數,惟重組病毒株臨床症狀與一般分支相,且皆無重症,接觸者追蹤亦未發現續發病例,評估整體風險維持不變。
SydaT1vhYVwa3HYYx6oXHA.en: Monthly update: since 2022 and up to 31 January this year, 144 countries and regions have reported more than 179,000 confirmed cases cumulatively, of which at least 483 died. In January this year, 50 countries and regions reported 1,334 new confirmed cases, including 3 deaths; 66% came from the African Region. Compared with December last year, case numbers rose in the European Region, while other regions declined. Case numbers are declining in all regions globally. Comoros and Réunion reported their first clade Ib cases. In the African Region over the past six weeks (5 January–15 February 2026), 20 countries reported 1,142 confirmed cases, including 4 deaths; the highest numbers were in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Guinea, Madagascar, Liberia and Ghana. Outside Africa, France, Portugal and Spain have continued to report clade Ib community transmission. WHO issued a global rapid risk assessment in February: sexual contact remains the main driver of cross-border spread. The global transmission risk is assessed as moderate; the risk for MSM populations, especially those with non-stable sexual partners, is moderate, and the risk for the general public is low. Globally, two recombinant viruses carrying Ib and IIb gene segments have been reported cumulatively: one in a patient in the United Kingdom with a Southeast Asia travel history, and one in a patient in India with a travel history to Arabian Peninsula countries. Genetic sequencing shows they are the same recombinant strain. WHO notes that actual case numbers may be higher than reported, but the clinical symptoms of the recombinant virus are consistent with ordinary lineages, none have been severe, and contact tracing has found no secondary cases; the overall risk assessment remains unchanged.

ABs7ogLnQzfYgwJFljc13w.zh: 印度西孟加拉州前於今(2026)年1月報告2例確定病例,其中1名25歲護理師感染後,長期昏迷,於接受治療數週後,仍因多種併發症於2/12死亡,為此波疫情之第1例死亡案例,另其近期之病毒檢測結果已轉陰性。
ABs7ogLnQzfYgwJFljc13w.en: In West Bengal, India, two confirmed cases were reported earlier in January this year. One of them, a 25-year-old nurse, remained in a coma for a long period after infection; after several weeks of treatment, she died on 12 February from multiple complications. She is the first death in this wave of the outbreak. Her most recent virological test has turned negative.

vcjLVRJBp37yWXZMBqJhpg.zh: 孟加拉西北部拉傑沙希專區瑙岡縣2/3報告1例確診病例,為40-50歲女性,於1/21出現發燒及神經等症狀,1/28死亡,1/29確診,個案曾於1/5-20期間多次食用生椰棗汁,目前對35名密切接觸者進行追蹤調查,截至2/3尚無新增病例。該國於2001年報告首例病例,迄今累計報告348例病例及250例死亡(CFR:72%),疫情常發生於12月至隔年4月,為椰棗汁的收穫及消費期間。該國自2016年以來,每年報告病例數多為10例以下,僅2023年報告14例,過去疫情曾報告人際傳播情形,惟近年來已減少。WHO評估於孟加拉/區域/全球之公共衛生風險為低,建議依現有資訊目前尚無須對孟加拉採取旅遊或貿易的限制。
vcjLVRJBp37yWXZMBqJhpg.en: In Naogaon District, Rajshahi Division, in north-western Bangladesh, one confirmed case was reported on 3 February: a woman aged 40–50 years who developed fever and neurological symptoms on 21 January, died on 28 January, and was confirmed on 29 January. The patient had repeatedly consumed raw date palm sap between 5 and 20 January. Contact tracing of 35 close contacts is ongoing, and no new cases had been found as of 3 February. The country reported its first case in 2001 and has reported 348 cases and 250 deaths cumulatively (CFR: 72%). Outbreaks usually occur from December to April, coinciding with the harvest and consumption period of date palm sap. Since 2016, the country has reported fewer than 10 cases a year, except for 14 cases in 2023. Human-to-human transmission was reported in past outbreaks but has decreased in recent years. WHO assesses the public health risk in Bangladesh, the region and globally as low, and, based on current information, recommends no travel or trade restrictions on Bangladesh.

Y1l-62rXxu1O1Fa6OlNxDA.zh: 印度衛生部於1/27說明國家疾病控制中心(NCDC)報告,自去年12月迄今,西孟加拉州(West Bengal)僅通報2例確診病例,監測並檢測196名接觸者均無症狀,且檢測結果均呈陰性。
Y1l-62rXxu1O1Fa6OlNxDA.en: On 27 January, India's Ministry of Health explained a report from the National Centre for Disease Control (NCDC): since December last year, only 2 confirmed cases have been reported in West Bengal. Monitoring and testing of 196 contacts found that all were asymptomatic and all tested negative.

LfXdZ8QQW602VUQNcLFpzA.zh: 印度南部坦米爾那都邦再次出現疫情,於清奈、琴阿爾帕圖、甘吉布勒姆、維盧布勒姆等地區之病例數上升,由於過去數年間當地病例數已下降,對於此次疫情上升,當局已加強監測、防治及宣導措施。 美國佛羅里達州邁阿密-戴德郡報告首例本土病例,於2025年12月發病,致該國2025年累計2例本土病例,另1例發生於紐約州長島西部的納蘇郡。
LfXdZ8QQW602VUQNcLFpzA.en: Tamil Nadu state in southern India has seen a renewed outbreak, with case numbers rising in areas including Chennai, Chengalpattu, Kanchipuram and Villupuram. Because local case numbers had declined over recent years, authorities have strengthened surveillance, control and awareness measures in response to the rise. Miami-Dade County in Florida, United States, reported its first locally acquired case, with onset in December 2025, bringing the US total for 2025 to two locally acquired cases. The other case occurred in Nassau County, on western Long Island, New York state.

VrvPKgNrfcGucMbNDnnj6A.zh: 印度西孟加拉邦疫情更新,截至1月24日累積5例確診病例,皆為醫護人員,當局已匡列約100名接觸者進行居家隔離;泰國迄今雖無報告病例,惟已於機場加強檢疫措施,並啟動健康一體的跨部門合作,發布警告,以監測此波疫情。
VrvPKgNrfcGucMbNDnnj6A.en: Update from West Bengal state, India: as of 24 January, 5 confirmed cases had been reported, all of them healthcare workers. Authorities have placed about 100 contacts under home quarantine. Thailand has reported no cases so far, but has strengthened quarantine measures at airports and activated One Health cross-sectoral collaboration, issuing warnings to monitor the outbreak.

MoLu_jS28GUGepj9mgR4mg.zh: 印度西孟加拉邦疫情更新,於1/11報告之2例疑病例,經複驗確診且病況危急,另有3名醫護人員亦出現症狀,刻正檢驗中。當局已匡列約120名密切接觸者包括醫護人員及其家屬,目前感染源仍不明,可能是人傳人,亦可能是從受污染的水果或新鮮椰棗樹汁中感染病毒;許多來自該邦之移工通常在此時間返回家鄉,冬季時,鄉村地區民眾亦傾向於飲用生棗椰汁。
MoLu_jS28GUGepj9mgR4mg.en: Update from West Bengal state, India: two suspected cases reported on 11 January were confirmed on re-testing and are critically ill. Three healthcare workers have also developed symptoms and are being tested. Authorities have identified about 120 close contacts, including healthcare workers and their families. The source of infection remains unknown and may be person-to-person transmission, or infection from contaminated fruit or fresh date palm sap. Many migrant workers from this state typically return home at this time of year, and in winter, rural residents also tend to drink raw date palm sap.

dGHlCexGmH_xSkxuDTYUTA.zh: 印度多邦疫情升溫,包含古加拉特邦(Gujarat)、北方邦(Uttar Pradesh)以及泰倫加納邦(Telangana),多為供水系統管線滲漏造成飲用水與汙水混合所致;據研究顯示,該國於2023年估計累計報告490萬例病例,其中7,850例死亡,且高氟喹諾酮(Fluoroquinolone)抗藥性是五歲以下兒童及高負擔地區之住院及死亡主因。
dGHlCexGmH_xSkxuDTYUTA.en: Typhoid is rising in several Indian states, including Gujarat, Uttar Pradesh and Telangana, mostly due to leaks in water supply pipelines that allow sewage to mix with drinking water. A study estimates that India reported 4.9 million cases cumulatively in 2023, including 7,850 deaths. Fluoroquinolone resistance is a major cause of hospitalisation and death among children under five and in high-burden areas.

jrfNdkyF2tlDOxvk3VNjgw.zh: 印度西部古加拉特邦報告1例男性病例,個案為26歲並從事農業及養殖相關行業,已於醫院接受治療,該邦約每2-4個月會報告病例,當局已於當地進行大規模監測作業。
jrfNdkyF2tlDOxvk3VNjgw.en: Gujarat state in western India reported one male case, aged 26, who works in agriculture and livestock-related industries and is receiving hospital treatment. The state typically reports cases every 2–4 months, and authorities have carried out extensive surveillance in the area.

PoQETsaLpiBRbsGs5Q64iQ.zh: 印度西孟加拉邦新增報告2例疑病例,皆住院隔離治療中,其中1例病情危急,病患皆為同一家醫院護理人員,近期無國內(其他邦)及國外旅遊史,檢體於1/11初步檢驗結果為立百病毒感染,已續送至中央單位進行確認,當局已啟動疫情應變小組及密切接觸者追蹤作業。病例發生於1月,與病毒出現的歷史季節性模式相符,並與椰棗樹汁採收有關。
PoQETsaLpiBRbsGs5Q64iQ.en: West Bengal state, India, has newly reported two suspected cases, both hospitalised in isolation, and one is critically ill. Both patients are nursing staff at the same hospital, and neither has recent travel history within India (to other states) or abroad. Preliminary test results on 11 January indicated Nipah virus infection, and samples have been sent to the central authority for confirmation. Authorities have activated an outbreak response team and contact tracing. The cases occurred in January, consistent with the virus's historical seasonal pattern, and are associated with the harvesting of date palm sap.

GKSGg7xtfhS7QyEE9AzhVQ.zh: 印度西部古加拉特邦(Gujarat)甘地納加市(Gandhinagar)1/6報告108例病例,疑為下水道滲漏汙染所導致,當局已調查約15萬人,發放氯錠及口服補液;另該國每年約報告470萬例病例。
GKSGg7xtfhS7QyEE9AzhVQ.en: In Gandhinagar city, Gujarat state, western India, 108 cases were reported on 6 January. The cases are suspected to have been caused by contamination from sewage leakage. Authorities have investigated about 150,000 people and distributed chlorine tablets and oral rehydration solution. India reports about 4.7 million cases each year.

2-hV5Jo7faZEGq7EdrES9Q.zh: 中國於2025年1-11月累計報告約1.8萬例病例,病例數為2024年同期1.4倍,疫情自5月起呈下降趨勢;印度喀拉拉邦(Kerala)2025年累計報告逾3.1萬例病例,其中死亡82例,死亡數創歷史新高。
2-hV5Jo7faZEGq7EdrES9Q.en: China reported about 18,000 cases cumulatively from January to November 2025, 1.4 times the same period in 2024. Cases have trended downward since May. In Kerala state, India, more than 31,000 cases were reported cumulatively in 2025, including 82 deaths, a record high number of deaths.

ey-aEDjotSBWGWAVyB_WNg.en: Global outbreak update: in 2025, as of 10 December, 41 countries and areas had reported 502,264 cases cumulatively (208,335 confirmed) and 186 deaths. WHO said widespread outbreaks occurred during the season in several regions, including areas where transmission had previously been low or absent, and assessed the global transmission risk as moderate. Regional situation: the Region of the Americas reported the most cases. Sixteen countries reported 291,451 cases cumulatively (110,039 confirmed) and 141 deaths, mainly Brazil with 243,915 cases and 116 deaths. The South-East Asia Region reported 115,985 cases cumulatively (7,097 confirmed), mainly in India and Thailand; India reported 108,379 suspected and 4,995 confirmed cases as of 31 August. The European Region reported 56,986 confirmed cases and 43 deaths cumulatively. France and Italy reported local cases. Separately, French Réunion reported 54,555 confirmed cases and 43 deaths cumulatively, and French Mayotte reported 1,259 local cases cumulatively. The Western Pacific Region reported 34,035 confirmed cases and 2 deaths cumulatively across 11 countries and areas; China reported 29,497 local confirmed cases, mainly 25,826 in Guangdong province. The African Region reported 2,211 cases cumulatively (111 confirmed), mainly 1,583 cases in the Republic of Mauritius; the Comoros, Kenya and Senegal also reported cases. The Eastern Mediterranean Region reported 1,596 cases cumulatively (67 confirmed), with Pakistan and Somalia reporting cases.

ci5C99ydUQ_N6uox2x4lkA.en: In Satna district, Madhya Pradesh state, India, 6 thalassaemia children aged 3–15 were reported with infection on 17 December. Five cases were transfusion-associated, and one is suspected to be a household infection. The patients need blood transfusions 2–3 times a month and tested positive in routine screening between January and May this year. Authorities are investigating the source of infection. Separately, Jharkhand state in the east reported 5 transfusion-associated infections in children in October.

4jcgyWQ17b_q-H-JZoRucA.zh: WHO於12/10報告今(2025)年截至11/30,全球季節性流感自10月起活動度上升,目前全球流行以 A(H3N2) 為主,另自8月起,多國之K分支檢出率上升,北半球部分國家的流感季較往年提早,南半球部分國家的流感季節較往年延長。西太平洋區自10 月起活動度增加,日本及韓國提早進入流感季,紐西蘭及斐濟活動度處高峰或上升, GISAID資料顯示截至11/21,西太平洋區之病毒序列有89%為K分支;東南亞地區自6月上升,8月達高峰後趨緩,惟部分國家活動度仍偏高,另GISAID資料顯示泊爾、印度、泰國已檢出K分支;北美洲地區活動度上升,美國及加拿大K分支檢出率增加;歐洲地區部份國家第45-46 週陽性率超過10%,流感季較往年提前約4週開始,其中西歐較早上升,65 歲以上住院比例增加;WHO 評估全球流感活動度上升仍在預期範圍,流感病毒與其他呼吸道病毒共同流行,可能對醫療系統造成壓力,多國已檢出A(H3N2) K分支,目前證據未顯示K分支有致疾病嚴重度提升之情形,疫苗仍預期能降低重症風險。
4jcgyWQ17b_q-H-JZoRucA.en: WHO reported on 10 December that, as of 30 November this year, global seasonal influenza activity has risen since October, with A(H3N2) currently predominant worldwide. Since August, detection of subclade K has increased in several countries. Some northern hemisphere countries' flu seasons began earlier than usual, and some southern hemisphere countries' seasons were longer than usual. In the Western Pacific Region, activity has increased since October, with Japan and South Korea entering the flu season early; New Zealand and Fiji are at or rising towards peak activity. GISAID data show that as of 21 November, 89% of virus sequences in the Western Pacific Region belonged to subclade K. In Southeast Asia, activity rose from June, peaked in August and then eased, although activity remains high in some countries; GISAID data show subclade K has been detected in Nepal, India and Thailand. In North America, activity has risen, with increased subclade K detection in the United States and Canada. In some European countries, test positivity exceeded 10% in weeks 45–46; the flu season began about four weeks earlier than usual, with Western Europe rising first, and hospitalisation among people aged 65 and over has increased. WHO assesses that the rise in global influenza activity is within the expected range. Influenza viruses are circulating alongside other respiratory viruses, which may put pressure on health systems. Several countries have detected A(H3N2) subclade K. Current evidence does not show that subclade K causes more severe disease, and vaccines are still expected to reduce the risk of severe illness.

I7lgLIhArwtC_eWrU2ch1Q.zh: 印度疫情更新,今年10月報告22,659例病例,較9月18,803例病例增加21%。今年截至10/31已累計91,015例病例,低於去年同期184,712例病例,去年全年共報告232,425例。 寮國疫情更新,今年1-11月累計11,629例病例及1例死亡,主要分布於永珍5,520例病例及1例死亡,該國去年報告逾20,000例病例及11例死亡。 美國佛羅里達州邁阿密-戴德郡近1週新增2例本土病例,該州今年迄今累計60例本土病例,主要分布於布里瓦德郡、希爾斯波羅郡、邁阿密-戴德郡及帕斯科郡,主要檢出型別為DENV-3;該州去年報告91例病例,2023年報告186例病例。
I7lgLIhArwtC_eWrU2ch1Q.en: India update: 22,659 cases were reported in October this year, a 21% increase over 18,803 cases in September. Cumulatively this year to 31 October, 91,015 cases have been reported, lower than the 184,712 cases in the same period last year; 232,425 cases were reported in the whole of last year. Laos update: 11,629 cases and 1 death were reported cumulatively in January–November this year, mainly in Vientiane Capital, with 5,520 cases and 1 death. The country reported more than 20,000 cases and 11 deaths last year. In Miami-Dade County, Florida, 2 new local cases were reported in the past week. The state has recorded 60 locally acquired cases so far this year, mainly in Broward, Hillsborough, Miami-Dade and Pasco counties, with DENV-3 the main serotype detected. The state reported 91 cases last year and 186 cases in 2023.

ZFOaPM1fli1E6evTB72w3A.zh: 全球疫情更新,今年累計報告458,840例病例及146例死亡,病例數較去年同期增加,10月報告病例數較9月增加108%,近2個月病例主要分布於美洲及亞洲。  今年美洲累計266,165例病例及118例死亡,較去年同期為低,以南美洲巴西病例數最多,其中,該國中西部和東南部地區在過去3週疫情最為嚴峻,並預期11月病例數將再度上升。 今年亞洲累計136,233例病例,較去年同期為低,以東南亞印度病例數最多;中國廣東省自7月疫情爆發以來,近期每週病例數呈下降趨勢,惟10月病例數較9月增加,香港及廣西壯族自治區亦有報告病例。 今年歐洲共2國報告病例,法國累計804例本土病例;義大利累計385例本土病例。
ZFOaPM1fli1E6evTB72w3A.en: Global update: This year, 458,840 cases and 146 deaths have been reported cumulatively, with case numbers higher than the same period last year. Reported cases in October rose 108% from September, and in the past two months cases have been mainly distributed in the Americas and Asia. The Americas have reported 266,165 cumulative cases and 118 deaths this year, lower than the same period last year. Brazil has the most cases; its central-western and south-eastern regions have been the most severely affected in the past three weeks, and case numbers are expected to rise again in November. Asia has reported 136,233 cumulative cases this year, lower than the same period last year. India has the most cases in South-East Asia. In Guangdong Province, China, weekly cases have shown a declining trend since the outbreak began in July, but October cases were higher than September. Cases have also been reported in Hong Kong and the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region. Two European countries have reported cases this year: France has 804 cumulative locally acquired cases and Italy has 385.

merfEYWK1Nnvtdpj6TuRLg.zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第42週(10/13-19)全球陽性率10.88%,其中,歐洲及東地中海區署陽性率增加。 日本疫情呈下降趨勢,第43週定醫平均報告數2.25,已連續6週下降,分布以東京都、神奈川縣為多,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 韓國疫情呈下降趨勢,第42週陽性率12.19%,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 東南亞疫情處低點,孟加拉、印度、泰國及泊爾等國第42週陽性率皆處低點。 澳洲疫情處低點,第41週定點實驗室監測陽性率降至1.2%,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高(52.3%)。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈波動下降趨勢,其中,東南亞、歐洲及東地中海區呈上升趨勢;全球流行變異株以XFG占比最高(占81%),其次為NB.1.8.1(占12%)。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
merfEYWK1Nnvtdpj6TuRLg.en: Update: The global positivity rate in week 42 of 2025 (13–19 October) was 10.88%, and the European and Eastern Mediterranean regional offices saw increases in positivity. Japan: The outbreak is declining. In week 43, the average number of reports per sentinel clinic was 2.25, having declined for six consecutive weeks. Cases are concentrated in Tokyo and Kanagawa prefecture, and the variant NB.1.8.1 has the highest share. South Korea: The outbreak is declining. The positivity rate in week 42 was 12.19%, and the variant NB.1.8.1 has the highest share. Southeast Asia: The outbreak is at a low point; positivity rates in week 42 were at low levels in Bangladesh, India, Thailand and Nepal. Australia: The outbreak is at a low point. The positivity rate in sentinel laboratory surveillance fell to 1.2% in week 41, and the variant NB.1.8.1 has the highest share (52.3%). Assessment and recommendations: Global positivity has recently shown a fluctuating downward trend, but Southeast Asia, Europe and the Eastern Mediterranean regions are rising. The globally circulating variant with the highest share is XFG (81%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (12%). WHO says most countries have included COVID-19 in routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and reliable testing, treatment and vaccines to the public, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report outbreak information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

U09_Ovfw7rkEfHGwJsl4eQ.zh: 印度喀拉拉邦疫情更新,今年截至11/4累計報告160例確定病例,其中36例死亡(CFR:22.5%),10月單月新增65例病例及12例死亡病例,其中以特拉凡德倫(Thiruvananthapuram)地區病例數48例為多,當局表示病原體存在於受污染之水源(如池塘和湖泊)中,可透過開放性傷口或鼻腔進入人體,警告年長及免疫功能低下者勿使用受污染之水清洗傷口或腳,另提醒民眾於季風後接觸未經處理之水源時,應保持警覺及遵守個人衛生。
U09_Ovfw7rkEfHGwJsl4eQ.en: Kerala state, India: As of 4 November this year, 160 confirmed cases had been reported cumulatively, including 36 deaths (CFR 22.5%). In October alone, 65 new cases and 12 deaths were reported, with the most cases, 48, in the Thiruvananthapuram area. Authorities say the pathogen is present in contaminated water sources such as ponds and lakes and can enter the body through open wounds or the nasal cavity. They warn older people and people with weakened immune systems not to use contaminated water to clean wounds or feet, and remind people to stay alert and maintain personal hygiene when contacting untreated water sources after the monsoon.

vCIq5L2yYOjzAvjuDm7Hgg.zh: 印度喀拉拉邦疫情更新,今年截至10/25累計報告149例確定病例,其中30例死亡(CFR:20%),10月單月新增56例病例及9例死亡病例,當局表示疾病監測/診斷能力提升致病例數上升,該國其他邦之多數腦炎病因仍未確定,惟井水、未清理之水塔、污染池塘與河川中皆檢測出阿米巴原蟲,已啟動環境污染源及傳播途徑之田野調查。
vCIq5L2yYOjzAvjuDm7Hgg.en: Kerala state, India: As of 25 October this year, 149 confirmed cases had been reported cumulatively, including 30 deaths (CFR 20%). In October alone, 56 new cases and 9 deaths were reported. Authorities say that improved disease surveillance and diagnostic capacity have contributed to the rise in cases. In other states of the country, the causes of most encephalitis cases remain undetermined, but amoebae have been detected in well water, uncleaned water tanks, and contaminated ponds and rivers. A field investigation into environmental pollution sources and transmission routes has been launched.

CZ_49AJRgiEeT3xPTFR6Vw.zh: 中國廣東省疫情持續,近1週(9/28-10/4)新增3,181例病例,主要分布於江門市2,480例,其次為佛山市、廣州市及肇慶市分別新增100餘例,無報告重症及死亡病例,江門市近期疫情仍處高點波動,由於假期人潮流動、氣候等因素致疫情傳播風險持續增加,當地已啟動突發公共衛生事件三級響應,全力展開防控工作。 全球疫情持續,今年截至9/30累計40國報告445,271例病例及155例死亡,部分國家/地區於今年發生疫情,包括近幾年病例數並不多之國家/地區。全球病例分布以美洲區最多,其中,以巴西疫情最為嚴峻;歐洲區之法國及義大利報告本土病例,法國今年疫情上升與法屬留旺島及印度洋地區疫情有關,法屬留旺島/馬約特島疫情已下降;東南亞區以印度病例數為多,孟加拉、泰國及斯里蘭卡亦報告病例;西太平洋區之中國廣東省截至9/27累計16,452例確診病例,分布於21城市,以佛山市10,032例及江門市5,209例為多,為該國有紀錄以來最大規模疫情,另廣西壯族自治區於9/1-21報告297例,福建省報告124例,其他省份如湖南省、四川省、海南省亦報告病例;非洲區以模里西斯共和國病例數為多;東地中海區之巴基斯坦及索馬利亞亦報告病例。WHO建議加強監測、實驗室及醫療保健能力、病媒監控,以降低疾病進一步傳播風險。
CZ_49AJRgiEeT3xPTFR6Vw.en: Guangdong Province, China: The outbreak continues. In the past week (28 September–4 October), 3,181 new cases were reported, mainly in Jiangmen city (2,480), followed by Foshan, Guangzhou and Zhaoqing, each with more than 100 new cases. No severe or fatal cases were reported. Jiangmen's outbreak remains at a high level with fluctuations. Because of holiday population movement, weather and other factors, transmission risk continues to increase. The area has launched a Level III public health emergency response and is fully carrying out prevention and control work. Globally, the outbreak continues: as of 30 September this year, 40 countries had reported 445,271 cases and 155 deaths cumulatively. Some countries and regions had outbreaks this year, including some that had reported few cases in recent years. The Americas have the most cases globally, with Brazil the most severe. In Europe, France and Italy reported locally acquired cases. France's rise this year is linked to outbreaks in French Réunion and the Indian Ocean area, while the outbreak in French Réunion and Mayotte has declined. In South-East Asia, India has the most cases, and Bangladesh, Thailand and Sri Lanka also reported cases. In the Western Pacific, Guangdong Province, China, had reported 16,452 confirmed cases as of 27 September, distributed across 21 cities, mainly Foshan (10,032) and Jiangmen (5,209), the largest outbreak on record for the country. Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region reported 297 cases from 1 to 21 September, Fujian Province reported 124, and other provinces such as Hunan, Sichuan and Hainan also reported cases. In Africa, Mauritius has the most cases. In the Eastern Mediterranean, Pakistan and Somalia also reported cases. WHO recommends strengthening surveillance, laboratory and healthcare capacity, and vector control to reduce the risk of further spread.

vDk0C0JCtydO9nLmm-iMnA.zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第36週(9/1-7)全球陽性率18.98%,除非洲及東地中海以外,各區署陽性率皆增加。 中國疫情於低點,第38週(9/15-21)門急診陽性率5.3%,較前一週下降,住院陽性率呈下降趨勢,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 香港疫情於低點,第38週陽性率下降至0.65%,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 東南亞疫情處低點,第38週報告病例數及死亡數均低,其中,印度及泊爾變異株以XFG占比最高,泰國以NB.1.8.1為主。 美國疫情呈下降趨勢,第37週陽性率9.5%,已連續3週下降,住院率亦呈下降趨勢,惟死亡率仍處高點。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈上升趨勢,除非洲及東地中海以外,各區署呈上升趨勢;全球流行變異株以XFG占比最高(72%),其次為NB.1.8.1(19%)。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
vDk0C0JCtydO9nLmm-iMnA.en: Update: The global positivity rate in week 36 of 2025 (1–7 September) was 18.98%, with positivity increasing in all regional offices except Africa and the Eastern Mediterranean. China: The outbreak is at a low point. The outpatient and emergency positivity rate in week 38 (15–21 September) was 5.3%, lower than the previous week, and the hospital positivity rate is also declining. The variant NB.1.8.1 has the highest share. Hong Kong: The outbreak is at a low point. The positivity rate fell to 0.65% in week 38, and the variant NB.1.8.1 has the highest share. Southeast Asia: The outbreak is at a low point. In week 38, reported cases and deaths were low; the variant XFG has the highest share in India and Nepal, and NB.1.8.1 predominates in Thailand. United States: The outbreak is declining. The positivity rate in week 37 was 9.5%, having declined for three consecutive weeks; hospitalization rates are also declining, but the mortality rate remains high. Assessment and recommendations: Global positivity has recently shown an upward trend, with increases in all regional offices except Africa and the Eastern Mediterranean. The globally circulating variant with the highest share is XFG (72%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (19%). WHO says most countries have included COVID-19 in routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and reliable testing, treatment and vaccines to the public, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report outbreak information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

VvnZgkDvVs3f4rI9EpOX4A.zh: 印度喀拉拉邦疫情更新,今年截至9/22累計報告77例確定病例,其中21例死亡(CFR:27%),今年病例數已超過往年疫情,且高於其他國家,病患主要集中於馬拉普蘭(Malappuram)區,當局已針對該邦水井、游泳池及水箱進行氯化處理作業,並警告民眾勿接觸不安全淡水。
VvnZgkDvVs3f4rI9EpOX4A.en: Kerala State, India, outbreak update: as of 22 September this year, 77 confirmed cases had been cumulatively reported, of which 21 died (CFR: 27%). This year's case count has already exceeded previous years' outbreaks and is higher than in other countries. Cases are concentrated in Malappuram District. Authorities have chlorinated water wells, swimming pools and water tanks in the state and warned the public not to come into contact with unsafe fresh water.

QOLRMmdUVCkSYX9T9wVv5g.zh: 迦納東部奧蒂區(Oti)今年截至8/28累計報告2.3萬例病例,較今年上半年(1萬例)增加快速;由於當地衛生條件不佳及廢棄物管理不當,當局已發布疫情警示,並加強對食物攤販之稽查。 印度北方邦瓦拉納西市(Varanasi)8月報告逾250例病例,較7月增加30%,且高於平時80至120例;當局呼籲民眾飲用煮沸過之水並保持良好衛生習慣,倘有症狀,應立就醫。
QOLRMmdUVCkSYX9T9wVv5g.en: In Oti Region in eastern Ghana, 23,000 cases had been cumulatively reported this year as of 28 August, a rapid increase from 10,000 in the first half of the year. Due to poor local sanitation and inadequate waste management, authorities issued an outbreak alert and intensified inspections of food vendors. In Varanasi City, Uttar Pradesh, India, more than 250 cases were reported in August, a 30% increase over July and above the usual 80–120 cases. Authorities urge residents to drink boiled water, maintain good hygiene, and seek medical care promptly if symptoms appear.

HoRZ3J9v3FMdytcR07KLCA.zh: 印度喀拉拉邦報告2例確定病例,其中1例死亡,案1為3個月大嬰兒,7月下旬住院治療,8/31死亡,案2為43歲女性個案,8/27轉診至科澤科德醫學院附設醫院,該院截至8/28累計有9名病患(包含4名兒童)住院治療中,分別來自科澤科德(Kozhikode)、瓦亞納德(Wayanad)及馬拉普蘭(Malappuram)地區。今年截至9/1累計報告15例確定病例,其中2例死亡,當局宣布啟動大規模衛教活動,並提醒民眾保持水源清潔及安全。
HoRZ3J9v3FMdytcR07KLCA.en: Kerala State, India, reported two confirmed cases, one of them fatal. Case 1 was a three-month-old infant, hospitalized for treatment in late July, who died on 31 August. Case 2 was a 43-year-old woman referred on 27 August to Kozhikode Medical College Hospital. As of 28 August, that hospital had nine patients hospitalized (including four children), from Kozhikode, Wayanad and Malappuram districts. As of 1 September this year, 15 confirmed cases had been cumulatively reported, of which two died. Authorities have announced a large-scale health education campaign and reminded the public to keep water sources clean and safe.

UQ4nSMsNJGERoUXXqVDmNA.zh: 印度喀拉拉邦疫情更新,今年截至8/23累計報告11例確定病例,其中1例死亡,死亡病患為科澤科德縣9歲女童,其7歲弟弟也確診收治於醫院,兩例個案皆曾在同一池塘洗澡,另該縣報告病例數上升,專家懷疑不同之新型菌株是造成近期報告病例之原因。當局已針對該縣發出疫情警報。 中國8月報告2例死亡病例,案1為福建省5歲女童(前已掌握), 於6/23住院後昏迷轉入加護病房,8/22死亡,病患於發病前曾進行游泳及泡溫泉活動;案2為安徽省6歲男童,於6/17出現發燒症狀,多次就醫後於27日轉院至上海醫院,30日確診,於8/11死亡,病患發病前曾於公園撈魚及學校玩水。當局提醒應避免在不乾淨的水源中戲水,倘至開放水域,需佩戴鼻夾及泳鏡,另應於出現急性發燒及劇烈頭痛及時就醫。
UQ4nSMsNJGERoUXXqVDmNA.en: Kerala State, India, update: as of 23 August this year, 11 confirmed cases had been cumulatively reported, one of them fatal. The deceased was a 9-year-old girl in Kozhikode District; her 7-year-old younger brother was also confirmed and hospitalized. Both cases had bathed in the same pond. Case numbers in the district are rising, and experts suspect that a different new strain may be responsible for recent cases. Authorities have issued an outbreak alert for the district. China reported two deaths in August. Case 1 was a 5-year-old girl in Fujian Province (previously identified): she was hospitalized on 23 June, fell into a coma and was transferred to intensive care, and died on 22 August; before onset she had been swimming and bathing in hot springs. Case 2 was a 6-year-old boy in Anhui Province who developed fever on 17 June; after repeated medical visits, he was transferred to a Shanghai hospital on 27 June, confirmed on 30 June, and died on 11 August. Before onset he had fished in a park and played in water at school. Authorities advise avoiding play in unclean water sources; when visiting open water, nose clips and goggles should be used, and people with acute fever or severe headache should seek medical care promptly.

DSYZbgWX4FDfuLnud0sDQw.zh: 本週摘要: 人類疫情:本週新增印度1例H5N1流感人類感染病例。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):  共8國於2025/8/14-2025/8/22期間報告25起H5N1疫情,挪威8起、英國5起、加拿大4起、西班牙3起、比利時2起、美國/葡萄牙/阿根廷各1起。 共2國於2025/8/18-2025/8/22期間報告7起H5 (N untyped)疫情,美國5起、比利時2起。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  牛場:去年3月迄今累計17州報告1,078起疫情,近期主要集中於加利福亞州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少9,600例,檢測218例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中出現貓隻死亡案例。 廢水監測:第33週計423個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中1州(紐澤西州)共1個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  年度摘要:  人類病例: H5N1流感27例 (2003年迄今累計990*例)、H9N2流感18例(迄今累計146例)、H10N3流感2例(迄今累計6例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。*依WHO統計將美國H5流感列為H5N1流感病例。 禽類/動物案例:累計57國家/地區通報2,182起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議: FAO/WHO/WOAH於7/28針對H5病毒風險評估,H5病毒(2.3.2.1a、2.3.2.1e及2.3.4.4b等)仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物或受其汙染環境相關,且未具人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生/飼養動物,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,一般大眾仍為低,於常接觸受汙染動物/環境者則為低至中,主要因素為接觸方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲加強對易感動物及高危險人群之監測,並避免飲用未經高溫殺菌之乳品,持續採取防疫一體(One Health)跨部門應對措施。
DSYZbgWX4FDfuLnud0sDQw.en: Summary for the week. Human cases: this week, one new H5N1 human infection was reported in India. Animal and poultry outbreaks (WAHIS): eight countries reported 25 H5N1 outbreaks during 14–22 August 2025, including Norway (8), the UK (5), Canada (4), Spain (3), Belgium (2), and the USA, Portugal and Argentina (1 each). Two countries reported seven H5 (N-untyped) outbreaks during 18–22 August 2025, the USA (5) and Belgium (2). Avian influenza in US dairy cattle: 1,078 herd outbreaks have been reported across 17 states since March last year, recently concentrated mainly in California. Human infections linked to cattle: at least 9,600 monitored, 218 tested, and 41 positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other derived outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep and alpacas, among others, including a cat death. Wastewater monitoring: in week 33, 423 sampling sites provided results; one sampling site in one state (New Jersey) detected H5-positive samples. Annual summary. Human cases: H5N1 influenza, 27 cases (990 cumulatively since 2003); H9N2 influenza, 18 cases (146 cumulatively); H10N3 influenza, 2 cases (6 cumulatively); most cases had exposure to susceptible animals before onset. Per WHO statistics, US H5 influenza cases are classified as H5N1 cases. Avian and animal cases: 57 countries and regions have cumulatively reported 2,182 high- and low-pathogenicity avian influenza outbreaks. Assessment and recommendations: On 28 July, FAO, WHO and WOAH completed a risk assessment of H5 viruses. H5 viruses (clades 2.3.2.1a, 2.3.2.1e and 2.3.4.4b, among others) remain avian viruses. Human cases were mostly associated with direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals or contaminated environments, and the viruses have no human-to-human transmission capacity. Because the viruses are widespread in wild and farmed animals, cases are expected to continue, and global public health risk is assessed as remaining low. Infection risk for the general public remains low; for people who often contact contaminated animals or environments, it is low to moderate. The main determinants are the mode of contact, duration, protective measures and control measures. Authorities call for enhanced surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups, avoidance of drinking unpasteurized dairy products, and continued One Health cross-sector response.

xSWZfJeyQOJyrDDzBL615Q.zh: 美國密蘇里州報告1例病例,成年病患於發病前幾日曾於奧札克湖(Ozarks)滑水,感染源調查中,該國於1962-2024年期間共報告167例,當局建議在溫暖之淡水中進行游泳或活動時,應採取相關預防措施。 印度喀拉拉邦報告3例病例,其中1例死亡,2例住院中,病患分別為3個月大嬰兒、9歲女童及1名青年,當局已啟動疫情調查、家庭篩檢及衛教宣導工作。該邦於2016-22年報告8例死亡病例,惟於2023病例數急遽增加,共計報告36例死亡病例。
xSWZfJeyQOJyrDDzBL615Q.en: Missouri State, USA, reported one case. The adult patient had been waterskiing on Lake of the Ozarks a few days before onset. The source of infection is under investigation. The US reported 167 cases in total during 1962–2024. Authorities recommend taking preventive measures when swimming or engaging in activities in warm fresh water. Kerala State, India, reported three cases, one of them fatal. Two patients are currently hospitalized: a three-month-old infant, a nine-year-old girl and a young man. Authorities have launched an outbreak investigation, household screening and health education. The state reported eight deaths during 2016–22, but case numbers rose sharply in 2023, and 36 deaths have been reported in total.

Tv7-cqzmStxq1jrbvRHvdA.zh: WHO公布印度喀拉拉邦新增3例確定病例,其中2例死亡,案1為18歲女性,於6/23發病,7/1死亡;案2為38歲女性,於6/25發病,病況危急並收治於加護病房;案3為57歲男性,於7/6發病,10日住院,12日死亡。當局已匡列共計723名接觸者,並針對該邦3縣市(科澤科德縣、馬拉普蘭縣及帕拉卡德縣)發出警示;該國今年累計報告4例病例,皆來自喀拉拉邦,該邦於2018年爆發首次疫情,另於2019、2021及2023-25年持續發生病例,WHO評估該疾病嚴重度高,目前尚無治療藥物及疫苗,且有進一步傳播可能性,此事件有造成嚴重公共衛生影響之潛在風險。
Tv7-cqzmStxq1jrbvRHvdA.en: WHO reports that Kerala State, India, has added three confirmed cases, two of them fatal. Case 1 was an 18-year-old woman who fell ill on 23 June and died on 1 July. Case 2 was a 38-year-old woman who fell ill on 25 June and is critically ill in intensive care. Case 3 was a 57-year-old man who fell ill on 6 July, was hospitalized on 10 July and died on 12 July. Authorities have identified 723 contacts in total and issued alerts for three districts in the state: Kozhikode, Malappuram and Palakkad. The country has reported four cases this year, all from Kerala. The state had its first outbreak in 2018, and cases have continued in 2019, 2021 and 2023–25. WHO assesses the disease as highly severe; there is currently no treatment drug or vaccine, further spread is possible, and the event carries a potential risk of serious public health impact.

_1g85uhR7EVu6etsw0Vw_Q.zh: 印度阿薩姆邦疫情上升,今年迄今已有32例病例入院治療及5例死亡(4名兒童及1名長者),病例主要分布於卡姆魯布縣(12例)、訥爾巴里(8例)及達讓縣(5例),自4月病例數開始上升,死亡病例多發生於6月,當局已對於該邦疫情發布警報。
_1g85uhR7EVu6etsw0Vw_Q.en: Assam State in India has seen rising cases. So far this year, 32 cases have been hospitalized and 5 deaths reported (4 children and 1 elderly person). Cases are mainly in Kamrup district (12), Nalbari (8) and Darrang (5). Case numbers have risen since April, and most deaths occurred in June. Authorities have issued an alert for the outbreak in the state.

adlcgemhebWUJt2EdRVaJg.en: Summary for this week. Human cases: India reported one new human H5N1 infection, and China reported two human H9N2 infections. Avian and animal outbreaks (WAHIS): eight countries reported 19 H5N1 outbreaks between 15 and 18 July 2025, with Brazil, Ireland, the United Kingdom, Portugal and Spain 3 each, Canada 2, and the Czech Republic and Cambodia 1 each. Two countries reported 2 H5 (N untyped) outbreaks between 16 and 17 July 2025, with Russia and Argentina 1 each. Canada reported 2 H5N5 outbreaks on 16 July 2025. US dairy cattle infections with avian influenza: cumulatively, 1,075 (0) herd outbreaks have been reported in 17 states since March last year, with recent activity concentrated in California and Arizona. At least 9,600 cattle-exposed humans have been monitored cumulatively, 218 tested, and 41 positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other derived outbreaks include infections in domestic cats, sheep and alpacas, including a cat death. H5 2.3.4.4b remains an avian virus; human cases mostly involved direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals, and there is no capacity for human-to-human transmission. bAic4krRoI1BhjUGehyFvQ.zh: 印度報告1例H1N1v流感人類感染病例,為喀拉拉邦一名中學生,於7/13出現症狀,同班級之另3名同學亦出現症狀,目前接受治療中,檢驗結果尚待公布。
bAic4krRoI1BhjUGehyFvQ.en: India has reported one human H1N1v influenza infection, in a secondary school student in Kerala State. Symptoms began on 13 July, and three other students in the same class also developed symptoms. They are currently receiving treatment, and test results have not yet been announced.

BsPZMGTWN8wJDXVdb0F8QQ.zh: WHO公布印度報告1例來自孟加拉西部庫爾納專區之H5N1病例,該病患於5月採集檢體,其後死亡,流行病學及接觸史皆不明,據報告該病毒屬2.3.2.1a分支,於孟加拉及印度之鳥類和家禽中傳播。該國於今年4月報告1例2歲女童病例,該病患因感染死亡。
BsPZMGTWN8wJDXVdb0F8QQ.en: WHO reported that India had identified one H5N1 case from Khulna Division in western Bangladesh. The specimen was collected in May, and the patient later died. Epidemiological and exposure history is unknown. The virus belongs to clade 2.3.2.1a and is circulating among birds and poultry in Bangladesh and India. Bangladesh reported a case in a 2-year-old girl in April this year, who died from the infection.

Hq86C_GLBhMLVBQEvCuJpw.zh: 澳大利亞新南威爾斯州報告1例死亡病例,為50多歲男性,病患於數月前被受感染之蝙蝠咬傷並接受治療,於7/3死亡,為該州首例死亡病例,該國自1996年迄今已報告4例,當局已啟動疫情調查,並呼籲民眾避免接觸蝙蝠。 印度北方邦報告1例死亡病例,為22歲男性,病患1個月前曾被犬隻咬傷,且未接種疫苗,於6/26出現呼吸困難,28日死亡,當局已啟動衛教宣導及疫苗接種服務。 南非東部夸祖魯-納塔爾省報告1例死亡病例,為32歲男性,曾於3月被犬隻咬傷,且未接種疫苗,於5/30死亡;該省去(2024)年報告3例,當局已啟動犬/貓隻疫苗接種服務。南非病例數前3名省份為夸祖魯-納塔爾、東開普及林波波省。
Hq86C_GLBhMLVBQEvCuJpw.en: New South Wales, Australia, reported one death, a man in his 50s who had been bitten months earlier by an infected bat and had received treatment. He died on 3 July, the state's first such death. Australia has reported 4 cases since 1996. Authorities have launched an outbreak investigation and urge the public to avoid contact with bats. Uttar Pradesh, India, reported one death, a 22-year-old man who had been bitten by a dog one month earlier and was unvaccinated. He developed breathing difficulties on 26 June and died on 28 June. Authorities have launched health education and vaccination services. KwaZulu-Natal Province in eastern South Africa reported one death, a 32-year-old man who was bitten by a dog in March and was unvaccinated. He died on 30 May. The province reported 3 cases last year, and dog and cat vaccination services have been launched. The three provinces with the most cases in South Africa are KwaZulu-Natal, Eastern Cape and Limpopo.

NRw0XcOrKkLkXOT48aTitQ.zh: 印度喀拉拉邦新增報告2例病例,分別為18歲及38歲女性個案,前者曾於醫院接受治療,並於7/4死於急性腦炎綜合症(AES),後者病況危急,正在醫院接受治療。目前已匡列425名接觸者,包括醫護人員。另該邦馬拉普蘭縣於今年5月曾確診1例病例。
NRw0XcOrKkLkXOT48aTitQ.en: Kerala State in India has reported two new cases, both women, aged 18 and 38. The 18-year-old had been treated in hospital and died of acute encephalitis syndrome (AES) on 4 July. The 38-year-old is critically ill and is being treated in hospital. A total of 425 contacts, including health workers, have been identified. In Malappuram District of the state, one case was confirmed in May this year.

-Wo_RwMKOZ1PJE2fqhi4mQ.zh: 印度西部馬哈拉施特拉邦(Maharashtra)浦那市(Pune)今年5月報告78例病例,較去年同期(58例)增加;另有研究指出,鄰近該邦之古吉拉特邦(Gujarat),該地區檢出之致病菌對常用抗生素之抗藥性日益增強。
-Wo_RwMKOZ1PJE2fqhi4mQ.en: Pune City in Maharashtra State, western India, reported 78 cases in May this year, up from 58 in the same period last year. A study also indicates that in Gujarat, which neighbors Maharashtra, pathogens detected in the area are showing growing resistance to commonly used antibiotics.

TEEthy_-_aneVY0fNVJGuA.zh: 全球今年迄今累計報告約220,000例病例及80例死亡,分布於美/非/亞洲、法屬留旺島及馬約特島,其中,美洲病例數最多,以巴西141,436例及阿根廷2,521例為多,亞洲之印度、斯里蘭卡及巴基斯坦等國報告逾33,000例,非洲塞內加爾亦有報告病例,另法屬留旺島/馬約特島分別報告逾51,000例及560例,ECDC評估歐洲目前環境愈來愈利於病媒蚊活動,當地疾病傳播風險增加。
TEEthy_-_aneVY0fNVJGuA.en: Globally this year, about 220,000 cases and 80 deaths have been reported cumulatively, in the Americas, Africa and Asia, as well as in the French overseas territories of Réunion and Mayotte. The Americas have the most cases, with Brazil reporting 141,436 and Argentina 2,521. Asian countries including India, Sri Lanka and Pakistan have reported more than 33,000 cases. Senegal in Africa has also reported cases. Réunion and Mayotte have reported more than 51,000 and 560 cases, respectively. ECDC assesses that the environment in Europe is increasingly favorable for vector mosquito activity, and the risk of local transmission is increasing.

eMknAbAG1TCSyAY-ZAab8w.zh: 印度疫情上升,今年截至6/12累計報告逾7,000例病例,其中206例為新興變異株XFG,其分布以西部馬哈拉施特拉邦(Maharashtra)為多,當局表示XFG具高度免疫逃脫特性,惟尚無證據顯示重症風險增加,該變異株別名Stratus,屬於Omicron後代,由LF.7及LP.8.1.2重組而成,最早於加拿大發現,自5月起,該變異株於印度等9個亞洲國家、英國等12個歐洲國家、美國及巴西之通報上升;血清研究顯示,XFG 變異株相對於 LP.8.1.1 之中和抗體效價下降約2倍,NB.1.8.1下降約 1.6 倍。
eMknAbAG1TCSyAY-ZAab8w.en: India's epidemic is rising. As of 12 June this year, more than 7,000 cases have been reported cumulatively, including 206 cases of the emerging variant XFG, most of them in the western state of Maharashtra. Authorities say XFG has strong immune-escape characteristics, but there is no evidence yet that the risk of severe disease has increased. The variant, also known as Stratus, is a descendant of Omicron and a recombinant of LF.7 and LP.8.1.2; it was first detected in Canada. Since May, reports of this variant have increased in 9 Asian countries including India, 12 European countries including the United Kingdom, and in the United States and Brazil. Serological studies show that neutralizing antibody titres against XFG are about 2-fold lower than against LP.8.1.1, and about 1.6-fold lower than against NB.1.8.1.

DvLdkYIyc2c_yOeMYEiinA.zh: 全球疫情更新,匈牙利疫情嚴峻,今年截至5月累計報告641例病例,為去年同期7倍;英國於6/12公布近期累計95例病例,其中58例住院,經調查推估有兩起群聚事件,其中1起之感染源為超市食品;印度南部喀拉拉邦(Kerala)於6/11報告51例病例,其中21例來自同一地區,懷疑為相同感染源,當局已發布疫情警報;中國今年截至5月累計報告近1萬例病例,為去年同期1.5倍。
DvLdkYIyc2c_yOeMYEiinA.en: Global update: Hungary's outbreak is severe. As of May this year, 641 cases have been reported cumulatively, 7 times the same period last year. On 12 June, the UK published that 95 recent cases had been reported cumulatively, 58 of whom were hospitalized. Investigation estimates two clusters, one of which had a food source from a supermarket. In Kerala State in southern India, 51 cases were reported on 11 June, 21 of them from the same area; they are suspected to share the same source, and authorities have issued an outbreak alert. China reported nearly 10,000 cumulative cases as of May this year, 1.5 times the same period last year.

ksxYENZEGP8hrNfhhCaBgg.zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第20週(5/12-18)全球陽性率3.19%,除美洲以外,各區域陽性率皆顯著增加。 中國5月累計新增約44萬例病例,其中606例重症、7例死亡,於5/26達高峰後,每日新增病例數開始下降;陽性率上升至第21週達今年新高(23.8%)後,呈下降趨勢,南方省份陽性率高於北方,變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高(92%)。 香港第22週(5/25-31)陽性率9.27%,低於前兩週,疫情仍處高點,惟已呈明顯下降趨勢,定醫就診率亦下降,污水監測數據顯示,變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高(94%)。 泰國今年截至5/27累計報告約21萬例病例,其中51例死亡,4月潑水節後,疫情持續上升,並以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高(65%)。 印度今年截至4/6累計報告近5,000例病例,病例分布以喀拉拉邦(Kerala)及德里為多,並以變異株JN.1占比最高。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈上升趨勢,其中,東地中海、西太平洋、歐洲及東南亞區皆呈上升趨勢;目前全球流行變異株以LP.8.1占比最高,NB.1.8.1占比持續上升。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
ksxYENZEGP8hrNfhhCaBgg.en: Epidemic update: in week 20 of 2025 (12–18 May), the global positivity rate was 3.19%, with significant increases in all regions except the Americas. China added about 440,000 cases in May, including 606 severe cases and 7 deaths. After peaking on 26 May, daily new cases began to decline. The positivity rate rose to this year's high of 23.8% in week 21 and has since declined; positivity in southern provinces is higher than in northern provinces, and the variant NB.1.8.1 accounts for the largest share (92%). Hong Kong's positivity rate in week 22 (25–31 May) was 9.27%, lower than in the previous two weeks. The outbreak remains at a high level but shows a clear downward trend, and the sentinel clinic consultation rate has also declined. Wastewater surveillance data show the variant NB.1.8.1 accounts for the largest share (94%). Thailand reported about 210,000 cases cumulatively this year as of 27 May, including 51 deaths. After the Songkran festival in April, cases continued to rise, with the variant NB.1.8.1 accounting for the largest share (65%). India reported nearly 5,000 cases cumulatively this year as of 6 April, mainly in Kerala and Delhi, with the variant JN.1 accounting for the largest share. Assessment and recommendations: global positivity has recently been trending upward, including in the Eastern Mediterranean, Western Pacific, European and South-East Asian regions. The variant LP.8.1 currently accounts for the largest share globally, while the share of NB.1.8.1 continues to rise. WHO notes that most countries have incorporated COVID-19 into routine respiratory infectious disease surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and trustworthy testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early-warning surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report epidemic information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

7ay5-Td-xuX-m5VV-sFsAA.zh: 印度東部奧里薩邦馬爾坎基里縣(Malkangiri)於5/19報告爆發不明原因疾病,已累計500餘例,症狀包含手腳腫脹、膝蓋與關節疼痛及發燒,當局已排除瘧疾及傷寒,病因待調查。
7ay5-Td-xuX-m5VV-sFsAA.en: In Malkangiri District of Odisha State in eastern India, an outbreak of an unexplained illness was reported on 19 May, with more than 500 cases cumulatively. Symptoms include swelling of the hands and feet, knee and joint pain, and fever. Authorities have ruled out malaria and typhoid; the cause is under investigation.

kzEa6qPwgqUkVtTMW6CKqg.zh: 印度南部喀拉拉邦報告今年首例,指標病例為馬拉普蘭縣42歲女性,於5/2出現腦炎症狀就醫,8日確診,目前病況危急,據調查2名家人亦出現相症狀,近期未食用水果或接觸蝙蝠,惟家中有雞隻死亡,將釐清是否與疫情相關。該邦自2018年以來已累計5起疫情共28例,其中22例死亡(CFR:78.6%)。
kzEa6qPwgqUkVtTMW6CKqg.en: Kerala State in southern India has reported its first case this year. The index patient is a 42-year-old woman from Malappuram District who presented with encephalitis symptoms on 2 May and was confirmed on 8 May. Her condition is critical. Investigation shows that two family members have also developed similar symptoms. The patient had not recently eaten fruit or come into contact with bats, but chickens had died in the household, and whether this is related to the outbreak is being clarified. Since 2018 the state has recorded 5 outbreaks with 28 cases cumulatively, of which 22 died (CFR 78.6%).

cGNF2RXTPMlUva8rZjjhJg.zh: 亞洲部分國家疫情上升,中國今年1、2月各報告約2,200例病例,為去年同期2倍;日本今年截至4/6累計報告41例病例,高於去年同期(26例);印度今年截至2/23累計報告10起群聚案件,高於去年同期(2起),病患多分布於南部喀拉拉邦(Kerala);韓國今年截至4/12累計報告360例病例,與去年同期(369例)相當;泰國今年截至3/22累計報告189例病例,第11-12週(3/9-3/22)疫情下降。
cGNF2RXTPMlUva8rZjjhJg.en: Outbreaks are rising in some Asian countries. China reported about 2,200 cases in each of January and February this year, double the same period last year. Japan reported 41 cases cumulatively this year as of 6 April, higher than the 26 in the same period last year. India reported 10 clusters cumulatively this year as of 23 February, higher than the 2 in the same period last year, with cases mainly in Kerala State in the south. South Korea reported 360 cases cumulatively this year as of 12 April, comparable to the 369 in the same period last year. Thailand reported 189 cases cumulatively this year as of 22 March, and the outbreak declined in weeks 11–12 (9–22 March).

3m8FWi1KZoeDjx3y8p3Org.zh: 印度東北部曼普爾邦爆發疫情,今年迄今已報告3例死亡,並報告700餘例咬傷,當局已採取預防措施,包含部分村莊被劃為隔離區,禁止寵物及流浪犬進入,並加強犬隻疫苗接種,疫苗供應不足為控制疫情之最大挑戰。
3m8FWi1KZoeDjx3y8p3Org.en: An outbreak has occurred in Manipur State in northeastern India. So far this year, 3 deaths and over 700 animal bite cases have been reported. Authorities have taken preventive measures, including designating some villages as quarantine zones, banning pets and stray dogs from entering them, and stepping up dog vaccination. Insufficient vaccine supply is the greatest challenge to controlling the outbreak.

A7Sp8wf78FpqxSfA5S1SBg.zh: 印度東北部特里普拉邦盛行率達0.33%,高於全國0.22%,2024年迄今年1月累計報告1,185例病例,自2015-24年累計報告512例死亡病例。當局表示該邦每月報告150-200例病例,其中多與藥物濫用相關,已採衛教宣導及藥物治療政策。
A7Sp8wf78FpqxSfA5S1SBg.en: HIV prevalence in Tripura State, in northeastern India, is 0.33%, higher than the national rate of 0.22%. From 2024 through January, 1,185 cases were reported cumulatively, and 512 deaths were reported cumulatively from 2015 to 2024. Authorities say the state reports 150–200 cases a month, most linked to drug abuse. Health education campaigns and medication-based treatment policies have been adopted.

U4tJVL8I_t9M7wYVjMOTpQ.zh: 泰國3/25報告自今年截至3/23累計3地區3例死亡,3例均曾被狗咬傷,且未接種疫苗。截至今年3/10,當局經檢驗發現動物檢體陽性率為6.19% (58/937)。 印度德里新增1例死亡病例,病患為成年女性,因飲用牛乳數日後死亡,據調查相關牛隻曾被流浪犬咬傷。當局提醒,牛隻被感染動物咬傷後其牛乳即可能含有病毒,應煮沸消毒;若傷口或黏膜被感染動物舔舐亦可能感染,應立即接受治療。
U4tJVL8I_t9M7wYVjMOTpQ.en: Thailand reported on 25 March that from the start of this year to 23 March, 3 deaths had been recorded cumulatively in 3 areas. All 3 had been bitten by dogs and were unvaccinated. As of 10 March this year, laboratory testing of animal samples found a positivity rate of 6.19% (58/937). India reported one new death in Delhi: an adult woman who died several days after drinking cow's milk. Investigation found the cow had been bitten by a stray dog. Authorities warn that milk from cattle bitten by an infected animal may contain the virus and should be boiled; infection can also occur if a wound or mucous membrane is licked by an infected animal, and treatment should be sought immediately.

glrKtAQ5EATmSwwAzT0LNA.zh: 菲律賓報告2024年全年累計426例病例,且所有病例均已死亡,其中,45%病例係寵物咬傷所致,2024年病例數高於2022、2023年。 印度報告2024年全年累計54例死亡病例,較2022年(21例)增加2.5倍,多數病例發生於馬哈拉什特拉邦,其中,30%病例為15歲以下孩童。WHO統計該國死亡數占全球36%,為狂犬病流行區。另該國2024年通報咬人事件累計219.5萬例,2023年為304萬餘例。
glrKtAQ5EATmSwwAzT0LNA.en: The Philippines reported 426 cumulative human rabies cases for the whole of 2024, and all of them died. 45% of cases were caused by pet bites. The number of cases in 2024 was higher than in 2022 and 2023. India reported 54 cumulative deaths for the whole of 2024, an increase of 2.5 times compared with 21 in 2022. Most cases occurred in Maharashtra State, and 30% of cases were children under 15. WHO estimates that India accounts for 36% of global rabies deaths, and it is a rabies-endemic country. In 2024 the country reported 2.195 million cumulative animal bite incidents; in 2023 it reported over 3.04 million.

QifIVwH4VklXi8fVddFs4A.zh: 全球今年截至1/22累計4國報告逾5,000例病例及2例死亡,分布於美洲(3國)及歐洲(1國);2024年累計報告約62萬例病例及213例死亡,分布於美洲、亞洲、非洲及歐洲,美洲病例數以巴西42萬餘例為多,其次為巴拉圭3,100餘例,亞洲病例數以印度19萬餘例為多,其次為巴基斯坦7,300餘例。
QifIVwH4VklXi8fVddFs4A.en: Globally this year, as of 22 January, 4 countries have reported over 5,000 cases and 2 deaths cumulatively, in the Americas (3 countries) and Europe (1 country). In 2024, about 620,000 cases and 213 deaths were reported cumulatively across the Americas, Asia, Africa and Europe. In the Americas, Brazil accounted for over 420,000 cases, followed by Paraguay with over 3,100. In Asia, India accounted for over 190,000 cases, followed by Pakistan with over 7,300.

_CDy1RxSD9XJSJNSQ85brA.zh: 印度於去(2024)年報告4,145例,顯著高於2023年1,194例,以喀拉拉邦疫情最為嚴峻,另查膜喀什米爾地區於近2年報告大量病例, 2023年報告450例,去年雖趨緩,惟仍報告95例;鄰近拉達克地區以往未報告病例,惟去年報告111例。
_CDy1RxSD9XJSJNSQ85brA.en: India reported 4,145 cases in 2024, markedly higher than the 1,194 cases in 2023, with the most severe outbreak in Kerala State. Jammu and Kashmir reported large numbers of cases over the past two years: 450 in 2023, and last year cases declined but still totalled 95. Neighbouring Ladakh had not previously reported cases but reported 111 cases last year.

hmht4frrYgnmxEJLmel9Jw.zh: 印度東部3個邦於2024年累計報告151例,其中以馬哈拉施特拉邦(下稱馬邦)報告140例為多,病例數為該邦自2021年以來最高,目前尚無小頭畸形或林-巴利症候群(GBS)報告病例。WHO表示該國自2016年報告首例後,多個邦均曾出現疫情,惟迄今尚無小頭畸形相關報告病例。該國境內埃及/白線斑蚊廣泛分布,另馬邦2024年之病例數高於往年,屬異常情形,另茲卡病毒感染症狀不明顯,臨床醫師認知程度不同,實際病例數可能低估。
hmht4frrYgnmxEJLmel9Jw.en: Three states in eastern India reported 151 cases cumulatively in 2024, of which Maharashtra State reported 140; this is the highest number for that state since 2021. No cases of microcephaly or Guillain-Barré syndrome (GBS) have been reported so far. WHO notes that multiple states have had outbreaks since the first case was reported in 2016, but no microcephaly-related cases have been reported to date. Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus are widely distributed across the country. Maharashtra's 2024 case count is higher than in previous years, which is abnormal. Zika virus infection often has inconspicuous symptoms and clinicians' awareness varies, so actual case numbers may be underestimated.

NPLoagYqwCttB8YBuDUf8Q.zh: 印度疫情更新,該國中部馬哈拉什特拉邦疫情上升,去年報告5,700餘例病例,為近6年以來最高,病例主要分布於那浦爾市;該國南部泰倫加納邦疫情上升,截至去年11/21累計逾400例病例。
NPLoagYqwCttB8YBuDUf8Q.en: India epidemic update: In the central state of Maharashtra, cases have risen; the state reported over 5,700 cases last year, the highest in nearly six years, mainly concentrated in Nagpur city. In the southern state of Telangana, the outbreak has risen, with over 400 cases reported cumulatively as of 21 November last year.

NHHpbjAwL9kDr0DcGQZFBQ.zh: 印度去年12/1報告全國平均盛行率為0.2%,其中,東北部阿薩姆邦盛行率為0.13%,較全國平均為低,惟新病例中,經注射毒品感染比率高達65%;另北部查謨和喀什米爾邦病例數逐年增加,目前仍有3,800餘例正在接受治療。
NHHpbjAwL9kDr0DcGQZFBQ.en: India reported a national average HIV prevalence of 0.2% as of 1 December 2024. In the northeastern state of Assam, prevalence was 0.13%, lower than the national average, but 65% of new cases were infected through injection drug use. In the northern state of Jammu and Kashmir, case numbers have increased year by year, and more than 3,800 people are still receiving treatment.

h_xg-piVxeSpDZ0OX4I9ow.zh: 北非摩洛哥、突西亞於去年第四季,各新增至少1例狂犬病死亡病例,病患均曾經犬隻咬傷,疫苗接種史不明;西亞以色列亦報告近8年來首例病例,為經犬隻咬傷,目前仍住院治療,當局已對接觸者進行預防接種;南亞印度馬哈拉什特拉邦新增至少1例死亡病例,病患曾被流浪犬貓咬傷,因無傷口而未接種疫苗。
h_xg-piVxeSpDZ0OX4I9ow.en: In North Africa, Morocco and Tunisia each reported at least one new rabies death in the fourth quarter of last year. All patients had been bitten by dogs, and their vaccination history is unknown. In West Asia, Israel reported its first case in nearly eight years, a person bitten by a dog, who is still hospitalised; authorities have given post-exposure vaccination to contacts. In South Asia, Maharashtra State in India reported at least one new death; the patient had been bitten by a stray dog or cat and, because there was no wound, had not been vaccinated.

HcdiYGzkBxKXVFJmPMxRaw.zh: 印度疫情更新,德里最近1週報告319例病例,於9月已報告3例死亡,今年迄今累計5,701例,低於去年同期的6,727例。
HcdiYGzkBxKXVFJmPMxRaw.en: India epidemic update: In Delhi, 319 cases were reported in the most recent week, and 3 deaths had been reported in September. So far this year, 5,701 cases have been reported cumulatively, lower than the 6,727 cases in the same period last year.

76WR8AI3rFQ7PP8OBEy-dw.zh: 印度疫情更新,德里今年截至11/30累計766例病例,病例數為近5年來最高。
76WR8AI3rFQ7PP8OBEy-dw.en: India epidemic update: In Delhi, 766 cases of malaria had been reported as of 30 November this year, the highest in five years.

WtLVifwPPTUCiHAHJ-lJBQ.zh: 全球今年截至11/30累計23國報告約48萬例病例,分布於美洲、亞洲、非洲及歐洲,其中逾200例死亡;美洲病例數以巴西40萬7,000餘例為多(203例死亡),其次為巴拉圭3,000餘例;亞洲病例數以印度6萬9,000餘例為多,其次為巴基斯坦5,000餘例。 印度疫情更新,德里今年截至11/30累計226例病例,病例數為最近5年來最高。 孟加拉疫情更新,今年迄今累計67例病例,主要分布於該國首都達卡。
WtLVifwPPTUCiHAHJ-lJBQ.en: Globally, 23 countries had reported about 480,000 chikungunya cases as of 30 November this year, distributed across the Americas, Asia, Africa and Europe, with over 200 deaths. The Americas reported the most cases, with 407,000+ in Brazil (203 deaths), followed by over 3,000 in Paraguay. In Asia, India reported over 69,000 cases, followed by over 5,000 in Pakistan. India epidemic update: Delhi has recorded 226 cases so far this year as of 30 November, the highest in the past five years. Bangladesh epidemic update: 67 cases have been reported so far this year, mainly in the capital, Dhaka.

N8qZIkaKCrRQLuXdYTuw7w.zh: 泰國東北部加拉信府疫情上升,今年截至12月初累計報告120例病例,其中3例死亡,當局表示東北地區發生率最高,且以務農工作者居多,呼籲民眾採取防護措施。 印度西北部拉賈斯坦邦12月初新增報告5例病例,為當地首起疫情,其中1例死亡;當局表示,因病原菌較適應潮濕環境,往年疫情多集中於中南部邦別,現在發生於乾旱地區,顯示菌株可能出現變化。
N8qZIkaKCrRQLuXdYTuw7w.en:
Cases are rising in Kalasin Province in northeastern Thailand. As of early December this year, 120 cases have been reported, including 3 deaths. Authorities say the Northeast has the highest incidence and that farmers make up most of those affected, and they urge people to take protective measures.

In Rajasthan State in northwestern India, 5 new cases were reported in early December, the first local outbreak in the area, including 1 death. Authorities say the pathogen is better adapted to humid environments, and past outbreaks were concentrated in central and southern states, whereas this outbreak is occurring in an arid region, suggesting the strain may be changing.

EQVoVf5JitcDphczMKe0AQ.en: India update: Delhi reported 1 case in a 72-year-old man on 28 November, the first case in the area in more than 10 years; the area had reported 14 cases in 2011. The country has reported 1,548 cases so far this year, with Assam State reporting the most, at 925 cases.

1xiJLHeE7J10NRQAr7Qd6A.zh: 巴基斯坦信德省疫情上升,今年迄今累計逾411例疑病例,其中153例確診。 印度東部西孟加拉邦馬爾達縣爆發疫情,迄今累計報告24例病例,當局已採取相關防治措施。
1xiJLHeE7J10NRQAr7Qd6A.en:
Pakistan: Cases are rising in Sindh Province. So far this year, more than 411 suspected cases have been cumulatively reported, including 153 confirmed cases.

India: An outbreak has occurred in Malda District, West Bengal State, in eastern India. So far, 24 cases have been cumulatively reported, and authorities have adopted relevant prevention and control measures.

yKSamJpcKdi6Ix1KoC3XDg.zh: 印度中部那浦爾市今年截至10/18報告1,000餘例病例,自8月以來病例數明顯上升,於9月份達高峰,近3個月報告約810例病例,10月病例數略降,然而當地近期降雨持續,可能造成病例數再次上升。
yKSamJpcKdi6Ix1KoC3XDg.en: Nagpur city in central India has reported more than 1,000 cases so far this year as of 18 October. Cases rose markedly from August, peaking in September, with about 810 cases reported over the past three months. Case numbers dipped slightly in October; however, continued recent rainfall in the area may cause case numbers to rise again.

N2YTR4gDP8q9U3wdZvQIdg.zh: 印度德里疫情上升,今年截至10/5累計511例病例,迄無死亡病例,病例數高於近4年同期,分別為2023年329例、2022年153例、2021年127例及2020年189例。
N2YTR4gDP8q9U3wdZvQIdg.en: Malaria is rising in Delhi, India. So far this year, as of 5 October, 511 cases have been cumulatively reported, with no deaths. The case count is higher than the same period in each of the past four years: 329 cases in 2023, 153 in 2022, 127 in 2021 and 189 in 2020.

ed6eBolTpKWWFX2Qqai8rA.zh: 巴基斯坦東南部信德省疫情上升,今年截至10/12累計報告166例病例,其中28例死亡,多集中於喀拉蚩市,當地專家表示該省抗毒素藥物短缺,接種疫苗仍為控制疫情之關鍵。 印度北部拉賈斯坦邦疫情上升,近1個月內新增報告6例死亡病例,均為10歲以下兒童,其中半數未接種疫苗,整體病例數未明,當局已介入調查。※該邦與巴基斯坦信德省相鄰。
ed6eBolTpKWWFX2Qqai8rA.en: Diphtheria cases are rising in Sindh province in southeastern Pakistan, with 166 cases reported cumulatively this year as of 12 October, including 28 deaths. Cases are concentrated mainly in Karachi. Local experts say the province faces a shortage of antitoxin medicine, and vaccination remains key to controlling the outbreak. In Rajasthan state in northern India, the outbreak is rising, with 6 deaths newly reported in the past month, all in children under 10, half of whom were unvaccinated. The overall case count is unclear, and authorities have launched an investigation. Note: this state borders Sindh province in Pakistan.

JbW5N2XCumpQIBrbv9_a1g.zh: 泰國今年截至10/8累計報告2,926例病例,以45至64歲族群為多,其中29例死亡,多為農民。 印度喀拉拉邦今年截至10/4累計報告約4,500例病例,其中2,512例確診,確診病例中155例死亡(CFR:6.2%)。 捷克9/29報告今年首例病例,為東部摩拉維亞-西利西亞州64歲男性,於9月中旬遭遇洪災,直接暴露於受汙染水源。
JbW5N2XCumpQIBrbv9_a1g.en: Thailand has reported 2,926 cases cumulatively this year as of 8 October, mainly among people aged 45 to 64; 29 died, most of them farmers. India's Kerala state reported about 4,500 cases cumulatively this year as of 4 October, of which 2,512 were confirmed; 155 of the confirmed cases died (CFR: 6.2%). Czechia reported its first case of this year on 29 September: a man aged 64 from the Moravian-Silesian Region in the east, who was directly exposed to contaminated water after floods in mid-September.

st4YT_kiZKMml4ANct7HAw.en: Globally this year as of 30 September, 23 countries have reported about 460,000 cases cumulatively across the Americas, Asia, Africa and Europe, and all 170 deaths were in Brazil. In the Americas, cases are highest in Brazil with over 391,000, followed by Paraguay with over 2,000. In Asia, cases are highest in India with over 69,000, followed by Pakistan with over 2,000.
